## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to a single feature module (or the reason is explained)
- [ ] New code lives in the folder the CONTRIBUTING.md "Where Does New Code Go?" table mandates
- [ ] Imports use the `@/` alias and cross-feature imports go through feature barrels
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (lint, format, type-check, test, build)
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed (`README.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.md` / `docs/`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `Unreleased` for user-visible changes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or PII are added to code, logs or analytics events
- [ ] The linked CI run for this branch is green
